# Vendor assets

Third-party pixel art, kept with its licence. Only CC0, MIT or CC BY assets are allowed here.

| Pack | Author | Licence | Source | What we kept |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pixel UI Pack | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/pixel-ui-pack | 13 nine-slice panels and buttons (Ancient tan/brown/white, Colored green/red/yellow) |
| Tiny Town 1.1 | Kenney (kenney.nl) | CC0 1.0 | https://kenney.nl/assets/tiny-town | 123 of 132 16×16 tiles: grass, paths, trees, roofs, walls, doors, fences, coin, sign, well, pots |

**Left out on purpose (school code of conduct: no weapons, blades, explosives or projectiles):** Tiny Town tiles 95 (archery target), 105 (bomb), 115 (pickaxe), 116 (pitchfork), 118 (bow), 119 (arrow), 127 (axe), 128 (hammer), 129 (sickle).

The game does not show these files directly. `scripts/unify-assets.py` recolours them into the game's single palette and writes the results to `src/assets/pixel/`.
